title: Automatic updates & What's new
changes: NEXA AI now tells you when a new version is available and downloads it for you with a progress bar.
After an update, a What's new screen shows what changed.
New: Settings → About → Check for updates.
Updates are signed with a permanent key, so future versions install over this one.

title: First release
changes: Dark Liquid Glass design with light mode.
Streaming chat powered by Groq, with a live model picker.
Professional code viewer: language label, line numbers, copy and download.
Local chat history: create, rename, search and delete.
